title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 4.00 (active) at 11:00 UTC on 9 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 9 日 11:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 4.00（活躍）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 4.00 (4Z) at 11:00 UTC on 9 October 2026. The 11 hour is complete (60 samples through 11:59; hour-start 4.00/4Z, hour-end 4.33/4P). Last-180 maximum is 4.33 (first at 2026-10-09T11:59:00Z; label 4P). Published-window maximum is 4.33 (first at 2026-10-09T11:59:00Z; label 4P). Window starts 2026-10-09T06:02:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 4.33. The 12 UTC hour on 9 October is incomplete (0 samples; feed ends at 11:59).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
